summary.text: Jeff Bathke is a Republican state representative from District 20 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a U.S. Army Reserve soldier and, in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, said he is the Davison County emergency manager and planning and zoning director.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Bathke was born in Mitchell, South Dakota, and has served in the U.S. Army Reserve since 1989.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Dakota in 1995 and a graduate degree from the same university in 2011.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Bathke said he has worked for state and local government for most of his career and serves as a Command Sergeant Major in the Army Reserve.
Bathke assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, and serves on the House Local Government Committee and the House Taxation Committee.
In the same survey, he listed his key messages as reducing government regulations, increasing technical education and affordable housing.
